title: [bundle] Remediate the residual prompt_hub fleet deployment drift rep
objective: Remediate the residual prompt_hub fleet deployment drift reported by hf fleet sync --dry-run: remove/neutralize tracked legacy .handoff/ledger.db, ensure .handoff/.gitignore guards ledger.db plus WAL/SHM, export ledger.events.jsonl, and prove hf fleet sync --dry-run reports zero remediations/failures afterward without disturbing unrelated prompt_hub dirty files.
acceptance_criteria: Residual prompt_hub fleet drift is remediated locally: hf fleet sync --dry-run reports remediated == 0, all_resolved == true, and zero failures.
Fleet status remains conformant: hf fleet status --json reports zero gaps.
prompt_hub ledger cache guard remains effective: git check-ignore matches ledger.db, ledger.db-wal, ledger.db-shm, and ledger.db.rvf.
Unrelated prompt_hub dirty files are not staged or committed for this task.
test_commands: hf fleet sync --dry-run --json | jq -e '.remediated == 0 and .all_resolved == true and ((.failures // []) | length == 0)'
